revisions.description: Keep Single Editor and Multi-Editor from replacing each other. About now shows Single Editor, and update packages are named SingleEditor.

Place the address book insert before the table of contents without counting it as a numbered page. Paper books can turn cut marks on or off. Inserted PDFs print at 600 dpi from the original file instead of a soft JPEG. Version number matches Multi-Editor 1.237.

Place the address book insert before the table of contents without counting it as a numbered page. Paper books can turn cut marks on or off. Inserted PDFs print at 600 dpi from the original file instead of a soft JPEG.

Keep Husband and Wife labels through Google sync instead of importing Other. Address Book print includes Meeting Data. Addresses stay in the name column, the contacts page has a Notes column and a fitted toolbar, and pa/pb notes use the book font.

Keep a much smaller Drive list from wiping local contacts, and stop a blank Drive value from clearing meeting/elder codes. Street 1 and 2 print on separate lines, wrapping names keep a trailing comma, and Notes explains pb/ and pa/ print codes.
Show street address 2 on its own line on the contact card and in Google Contacts.
Swap left and right margins on even pages for side-spiral paper books so the extra gutter stays on the bound edge.
Rename the catch-all shared group in place from Save Settings.
Leftover-contact cleanup, long-address wrap, cover-picture persist, and paper-book left-flush margins.
CFS Single Editor baseline. Separate update feed from the multi-editor ContactsFreeShare app.
